title: FBI Photo B23
doc_notes: This document is an FBI submission to AARO containing a redacted infrared sensor still image of an unidentified object, noting that the system timestamp is incorrect.

incidents.summary: A grainy, monochrome infrared sensor image showing a single dark, oblong object near the center of a targeting reticle.
incidents.quote: A small, dark, oblong or pill-shaped object is visible just to the right of the crosshair's vertical line
